title: Here's where you can still buy an iPod touch - 9to5Mac
snippet:
While we don’t have exact inventory counts, here’s what we know is in stock. We’ll continue to update periodically as inventory changes.

## Apple

On Apple’s website, the iPod touch is completely sold out.

## Best Buy

Best Buy is sold out of all of the 32GB options with the exception of the Space Gray model. For 128GB, you can still buy a Blue and a Space Gray. Additionally, all of the 256GB models are out of stock. [...] ## Walmart

Walmart is where you’ll find some of the best prices for an iPod touch. 32GB is no longer available in Blue or (PRODUCT)RED. The 128GB is available in Space Gray and Pink. Walmart is entirely sold out of 256GB options as those seem to be the most popular models at many retailers.

## Amazon

The iPod touch is currently listed as a best seller on Amazon and there’s even a 5% discount on what’s available. The 32GB is available in Pink, Space Gray, and Gold. [...] Best Buy includes three months of Apple TV+, six months of Apple Music, and six months of Apple News+ for free when you purchase an iPod touch. Each subscription is for new subscribers only.

## Target

Target only has a 32GB option available for both the Blue and Space Gray models. Every other iPod touch is sold out.

For new subscribers, Target does offer four months of Apple Music for free through its Target Circle program.

title: Apple Kills iPod Nano and Shuffle
snippet:
In a show of its commitment to the iPod Touch, Apple doubled the storage capacity of its top-of-line model to 128 gigabytes. That version costs $300. An iPod Touch with 32 gigabytes of storage sells for $200.
